about.hero_desc: A reliable bridge between real estate developers and domestic as well as international investor networks.
about.vision_desc_1: Founded with the goal of transparent and professionalizing the real estate M&A market in Vietnam, M$AVietnam is proud to be a pioneer platform connecting high-quality investment opportunities.
about.vision_desc_2: We understand that every real estate M&A deal requires a deep understanding of the market, legal, and financial aspects. With a team of experienced experts, we are not only a connector but also a reliable consultant throughout the transaction process.
about.value_1_desc: All project information is preliminarily evaluated, ensuring authenticity and clear legal status before being introduced to investors.
about.value_2_desc: We strictly adhere to the NDA process, ensuring that transaction information and client identity are kept strictly confidential.
about.value_3_desc: Shorten the time to find partners and negotiate through a deep connection network and professional workflow.
about.team_desc: The leading experts behind the success of real estate M&A deals.
about.partner_desc: Discover large-scale real estate investment and distribution cooperation opportunities with MNA International.

privacy.title: Personal Data Protection Policy
privacy.description: Personal data protection policy according to current laws at M$A International.
privacy.intro: M$A International respects and commits to protecting the personal data of Users. This Personal Data Protection Policy ("Policy") is established to comply with Personal Data Protection Law No. 91/2025/QH15 (hereinafter referred to as "Law No. 91/2025/QH15") and current guiding documents of Vietnam, as well as applying appropriate international security standards.
privacy.section_1_desc: We only collect your Personal Data for the following specific and legitimate purposes:
privacy.section_1_item_1: Receiving, processing, and evaluating M&A project submission profiles.
privacy.section_1_item_2: Connecting Project Owners with potential Investors (only with explicit consent).
privacy.section_1_item_3: Contacting, supporting customers, answering inquiries, and sending important notifications.
privacy.section_1_item_4: Improving user experience and optimizing the M$A International Platform.
privacy.section_1_item_5: Complying with legal, accounting, and auditing obligations as required by competent State authorities.
privacy.section_2_desc: The data we collect includes, but is not limited to:
privacy.section_2_item_1: Basic personal data: Full name, title, organization/company name, phone number, email address.
privacy.section_2_item_2: Transaction data: Detailed project information (scale, location, estimated value, attached documents), investment profile/credentials.
privacy.section_2_item_3: Technical data: IP address, browser type, access time, cookies used for website operation.
privacy.section_3_title: 3. Principles of data processing (According to Article 3, Law No. 91/2025/QH15)
privacy.section_3_desc: We are committed to processing your data based on the core principles of Law No. 91/2025/QH15:
privacy.section_3_item_1: Legality & Transparency: All collection and processing activities are clearly communicated.
privacy.section_3_item_2: Purpose Limitation: Only used for notified and consented purposes.
privacy.section_3_item_3: Data Minimization: Only collect data strictly necessary for M&A transactions.
privacy.section_3_item_4: Security & Safety: Apply strict technical and organizational measures (data encryption, VBSEC monitoring system) against unauthorized access or disclosure.
privacy.section_4_desc: According to Law No. 91/2025/QH15, as a Data Subject, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.section_4_item_1: Right to know & Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold.
privacy.section_4_item_2: Right to rectification: Request updates or corrections when data is no longer accurate.
privacy.section_4_item_3: Right to deletion & Withdraw consent: Request deletion of project profile data or withdraw consent for data processing at any time. However, withdrawing consent may affect the investor connection process.
privacy.section_4_item_4: Right to restrict processing & Object: Request to restrict data sharing with certain third parties.
privacy.section_4_contact: To exercise these rights, please contact us via email:
privacy.section_5_item_1: Storage: Your data is securely stored on cloud server systems with international standard encryption mechanisms. Storage duration lasts until the processing purpose is completed or upon your deletion request.
privacy.section_5_item_2: Sharing (Third Parties): In the M&A sector, confidentiality is paramount. We only share your Teaser/Project Profile with reputable institutional Investors (who have signed an NDA) after obtaining your written/email consent. Your data is never sold to third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.section_6_desc: M$A International applies the strictest information security standards against security vulnerabilities. In the event of a Data Breach, we commit to complying with the personal data breach notification process to the Specialized Personal Data Protection Agency (under the Ministry of Public Security) and to you within 72 hours as required by law.
privacy.section_7_desc: For any inquiries or complaints regarding the Personal Data Protection Policy, please send to:
privacy.section_7_item_1: Data Controller: Data Protection Board - M$A International
